word_prompts.text: When you hear 'flood warning', what words come to mind?
What would make a flood message easy to trust?

likert_stimuli.title: SMS text alert
likert_stimuli.body: FLOOD ALERT: Heavy rain expected tonight. Move to higher ground if you are near the river.

likert_stimuli.title: Community radio notice
likert_stimuli.body: A spoken radio announcement warning residents of rising water levels over the next 12 hours.

text_items.label: Plain SMS
text_items.body: Flood likely tonight. Move valuables up and stay away from the river.

text_items.label: Detailed SMS
text_items.body: Met service forecasts 80mm rain by 9pm; river may rise 1.5m. Evacuate low-lying zones A and B.
